 Good morning,
 Thank you for contacting the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners Office, your email will be forwarded to the
 Commissioners.

 On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 1:10 PM William Meyerchak  wrote:
  Dear TreePeople Departments and TreePeople Park Operations (Mr. Moreno),

  I'm a Los Angeles resident writing about Southern California Wildfire Response (SCWR), the volunteer group that
  KCRW reported does brush clearance and red-flag-day fire watch at your Coldwater Canyon Park headquarters. I'm not
  writing to criticize that work, which your team has spoken well of. I want to make sure you're aware of how SCWR
  describes its connection to your property.
